cases.name: IX1 mallet mf stroke on C4 near the centre
IX2 slow lowering (0.2 m/s) is silent and mutes 150 ms after it reaches the bar
IX3 dead stroke: an f stroke on G4, the head held 10 mm under the plane for 0.4 s
IX3b the same with dead strokes off (lessons; before tip_marimba_dead): no mute
IX4 F#4 struck at its tip (u .04)
IX4b F#4 struck 6 mm in front of its near end (u -0.02): END_REACH plays it at u 0
IX5 stroke into the 6 mm gap between C4 and D4 picks the nearer bar
IX6 roll on A4: alternating mallets about 10 strokes/s
IX7 a fingertip (no mallet) plays C5 softly
IX8 a resting hand mutes D4 after 120 ms, lifting releases it
IX9 tracking jump (27 m/s) never strikes
IX10 tracking returns below the plane: silent
IX11 a sideways sweep 2 cm under the plane plays nothing
IX12 velocity ladder point: 2.8 m/s on C4 gives vel 1
IX13 a soft VR stroke on E4 (0.6 m/s, 5 cm overshoot, 60 ms pause at the bottom) is a stroke, never a dead stroke
IX14 a full stroke at 9 m/s (10 cm per sample) on C4 gives vel 1
IX15 a fingertip tap-and-stay on E4 (two tips on the bar) sounds and never mutes itself
IX16 index first: a lower middle tip over D4 waits one sample, the index plays E4, D4 never sounds
IX17 a mallet resting on G4, 20 s with 6 mm head jitter: muted, no phantom strikes
IX18 six fingertip strokes, no mallet: the fingerOnly signal
